purpose: Evaluate whether the selected 180-day member-history decay candidate improves member/chamber forecasts without materially degrading rare final-passage failure discrimination before any production model change.

scope.events: all replayable historical passage events with strict pre-vote bill text, unchanged Quick analogues, active roster, and at least 20 decisive member outcomes
scope.reason: This slice contains 9 of the 12 observed passage failures in the historical corpus and therefore carries most of the available failure-discrimination information.

frozenSafetyRule.interpretation: All thresholds must pass to classify decay-180 as passage-safe-for-production-review. A failed threshold blocks production promotion from this research line. Passing still does not change production.

reportedMetrics: passed-event passage Brier and mean passage probability
failed-event passage Brier and mean passage probability
paired event-level passage-probability and expected-Yes deltas

guardrails.warning: The candidate was selected after historical outcomes were inspected. This audit is a safety check, not an independent confirmatory validation.
